rules.externalRuntimeDependencyPolicy: Avoid unless an upstream add-on must remain separate. Separate BP script realms cannot import each other directly.
rules.sourcePinning: Every active source is pinned to a reviewed Git commit SHA.
rules.collisionPolicy: All imported identifiers and file names are remapped into the lb namespace before entering BP/RP.
rules.licensePolicy: vendored assets require verified redistribution/modification permission; reference-only sources never enter distributable packs.
rules.productionPackPolicy: Final distributable remains one BP + one RP with mutual dependencies; do not add required dependencies on external packs.
rules.sidecarPolicy: Sidecars are exceptional interoperability targets, not the normal shipping architecture. Prefer vendored merge when redistribution/modification is licensed.

Original CC0 Slasher item/attachable/FP+TP geometry/animations/beam entities/particles/textures/sounds remain vendored. The original 1.18 item-extender/state-machine source is retained for provenance but is no longer runtime authority after real 2.9.0 testing showed unreliable combat. Lucky 0.39 uses a stable entityHitEntity/itemStartUse bridge that reuses the source fast/charged animations, sounds and beam implementation while keeping the post-dragon Legendary identity.
Original Diamond Staff inventory art retained; old item definition is ported to current Bedrock item components and used as the offhand 1.20x focus for the Mythic spell set.
Original Meteor model/texture, Spellbook texture and flame-summoning particle art retained. Old summon/explosion event chain is rebuilt in Script API as a falling telegraphed Mythic AoE spell.
Original Advanced Gigavolt spell role is rebuilt as aimed chain lightning with current Script API damage and Lucky late-game balance; shared original Spellbook art is owned by the Meteor record.
Preserves the upstream Advanced Tome concept of firing Minecraft's Dragon Fireball, with Lucky-owned impact damage/cooldown and the post-dragon gate.

Original Java Mantis model proportions and WALK/SCUTTLE/STRIKE/FLAP keyframes are converted to Bedrock coordinates; original texture and three OGG sounds are vendored unchanged. Java AI is reimplemented as post-dragon habitat spawning, leap pressure, melee poison and event participation.

Original 43-part / 90-cube Java model and 40-channel WALK animation are converted to Bedrock coordinates; original texture is vendored unchanged. Source melee stats/large-body identity are Lucky-rebalanced. Upstream RangedAttackMob hook is empty, so the telegraphed Silk Snare is explicitly Lucky-owned and reuses already-vendored BOMD indicator/burst particles.

The upstream fishing-hook lifecycle/custom-event pattern is adapted for @minecraft/server 2.9.0: custom EventSignal dependency removed, deprecated isValid() polling removed, hook/cast matching hardened for same-tick ordering and multiplayer, and catch confirmation still requires an actual spawned item near a water-entered fishing hook.

Original Irk model, WALK animation and texture are ported. Lucky adds a companion/taming role using official Bedrock tameable/follow-owner components; Rare Lucky Blocks spawn the companion and Script API tames it to the opener.
Original medium Ent model, WALK animation and oak texture are ported. Source retaliatory melee identity is preserved; Lucky binds it to the permanent pre-dragon Awakened Grove structure event.

Original Ant Soldier model, WALK/AMBIENT animation data and wood-soldier texture are ported. The upstream renderer's 1.5x visual scale is baked into Bedrock geometry. Lucky converts the neutral soldier-ant identity into an Epic tameable player-controlled mount using official Bedrock rideable/input_ground_controlled/player_ride_tamed components.

Original Amethyst Staff visual and ranged-staff concept are reused. Lucky rebuilds firing for stable Script API raycasts: a three-shot line-of-sight burst that does not require the Custom Projectiles experiment. Damage, cooldown and durability are Lucky balance.
Original Tomemancy amethyst-orb icon is reused as the finite ammunition identity for Lucky's Amethyst Repeater. The renewable shapeless survival recipe is Lucky-owned.

Original Wither Spider model, WALK animation, 1.2x renderer scale and texture are ported. Source melee Wither identity remains. Lucky adds a clearly documented dodgeable ranged/control volley and Nether ecology role; that ranged mechanic is not attributed to upstream.

Original Tomemancy Mystical Armor item icons, wearable texture and vanilla-humanoid attachable layout are directly reused under lb IDs. Source protection profile 1/4/3/2 is retained. Lucky increases durability/repairability for persistent gear and adds the documented full-set Aegis Ward recharge mechanic inspired by the source Aegis armor-replacement spell.

Original Wudu model, CRAWL animation and oak texture are ported from the MIT source. Upstream Wudu currently defines an empty WuduGrabGoal whose canUse() always returns false, so Lucky does not claim an upstream grab attack. The telegraphed grasp/pull and nearby ally Resistance aura are explicitly Lucky-owned post-dragon control/support mechanics.

Original Queen Ant model, 3-second WALK animation and wood-queen texture are ported from the pinned MIT Slayers-Beasts source, with the upstream renderer's 1.5x scale baked into Bedrock geometry. Upstream AntQueen is a neutral persistent-anger melee mob with 25 HP / 2 attack / 0.22 movement and no summon mechanic. Lucky's Royal Anthill structure, always-hostile encounter role, telegraphed Mandible Crush, phase reinforcements and War Ant completion reward are project-owned gameplay.

Original 16-cube Blockbench Java-block geometry converted to Bedrock geometry and the embedded 64x64 PNG imported byte-identically. Lucky-owned behavior turns the placed reward into a stationary 96-shot line-of-sight auto-turret and uses the same production asset in the Fortune Bulwark defense event.

All four source draw-state models are converted into four bones in one Bedrock attachable (16/19/19/19 cubes preserved) and switched by stable query.item_in_use_duration. The shared embedded 32x32 bow_1.png is vendored unchanged. Charge timing, arrow consumption, raycast hit logic, damage/range tiers and piercing are Lucky-owned gameplay.

Source Damselfly 10-cube body/wing silhouette and four-wing FLY/PERCH animation data are converted to Bedrock; original blue texture is vendored unchanged. Lucky scales the model to mount size and adds post-dragon taming, riding, 3D air control, 30-second flight energy, dismount recharge and reward gating. Upstream flight/perch identity and fall-damage immunity are preserved; rideability/stamina are project-owned.

All 7 source cubes are converted into a head-bound Bedrock attachable using the official custom wearable binding pattern. The embedded 32x32 source PNG is vendored unchanged. Protection, durability and two-piece exploration effects are Lucky-owned gameplay.

The source contains 10 Blockbench cube elements: 7 forward-visible cuboids plus 3 inverted duplicate/backface elements. Bedrock entity geometry ports the 7 physical cuboids and uses entity rendering for the backfaces rather than duplicating inverted cubes. The embedded 32x32 PNG is vendored unchanged. Chest-slot wearability and multiplayer-aware set effects are Lucky-owned.

Source 7-cube Butterfly model, tortoiseshell texture, 0.8 renderer scale and IDLE_CLOSED/FLYING animation identity are converted to Bedrock. Source 6 HP / 0.25 movement / free-flight / perch identity is retained as the behavior reference. Lucky-owned additions are sanctuary event spawning, event-only population stabilization/tethering, four observation stations, cooperative shared survey state and rewards.

Source 5-cube thrown geometry, 5-cube held geometry, bounce/in_air animation data, both textures and six Javelin sounds are directly ported. Source 10-tick minimum draw, 60-tick full charge, stack-16 economy, block sticking, crouch recovery and bounce-platform identity are retained. Bedrock uses a normal entity plus stable Script API impulse/raycast rather than the experimental Custom Projectiles toggle. Lucky balance raises hit damage to 8-18 and adapts Java velocity to Bedrock impulse. The shared inhabitants_arsenal.js also implements Spike Drill behavior. 0.39 runtime correction: numeric animation transforms/timing are retained, while non-Bedrock keyframe wrappers (`vector`, nested pre/post.vector) are flattened to Bedrock arrays and unsupported source easing metadata is removed so the actor-animation schema is valid.

Source 2342 durability, 120 heat cap, 300-tick momentum ramp, 40-tick overheat lockout, 2 damage overheat penalty, delayed passive cooling and snowball -30 quench identity are retained in the Bedrock port. Original base item texture and start/loop/stop/dig sounds are direct-use assets. Java loot-table mining becomes explicit Bedrock block-form salvage using stable Block.getItemStack; containers, custom Lucky blocks and protected/unbreakable progression blocks are excluded. Source temperature sprite overrides are not claimed ported; heat/momentum are surfaced in actionbar until a stable non-placeholder item-state visual path is bound.

CC0 Blockbench 10-element hat geometry converted to a Bedrock head attachable using the source head scale; embedded wizard_hat.png decoded directly. Lucky-owned Arcane Focus grants +15% Tomemancy spell power and 15% cooldown reduction.

CC0 three-element glasses geometry converted to a Bedrock head attachable using the source head scale; embedded PNG decoded directly. Lucky-owned Threat Lens provides night vision, clears blindness/darkness, and reports monster-family threats within 24 blocks.

CC0 Blue Pop Can uses one source texture across the complete source model; that embedded production PNG is decoded directly as the portable item icon. Lucky-owned consumable behavior adds short defensive status effects.

LGPL Gauntlet 26-bone/42-cube geometry and all ten source combat animations are direct ports with identifier/key namespace remapping only; entity texture and seven source sounds are byte-identical. Lucky Bedrock mechanics preserve punch, delayed laser, spin punch, blindness, poison/wither immunity and energy-shield identities with telegraphs/counterplay instead of copying Java implementation code. 0.39 runtime correction: numeric animation transforms/timing are retained, while non-Bedrock keyframe wrappers (`vector`, nested pre/post.vector) are flattened to Bedrock arrays and unsupported source easing metadata is removed so the actor-animation schema is valid.

Source block is cube_all with gauntlet_blackstone texture. Bedrock port keeps that cube identity and exact source texture; Lucky uses three temporary breakable anchors to expose the boss during 65% and 30% shield phases.

LGPL Void Blossom 67-bone/91-cube geometry and all eight source animations are direct namespace/identifier remaps; entity texture and five source sounds are byte-identical. Source 350 HP / 4 armor / 12 attack stationary boss identity, spike burst/wave, spore, petal blade and milestone blossom behavior inform Lucky's pre-dragon 420 HP encounter. Lucky adds explicit telegraphs, breakable Flowering Azalea life roots at 75/50/25%, 0.65x guarded damage and 1.35x post-cleanse vulnerability inside the persistent Void Garden structure. 0.39 runtime correction: numeric animation transforms/timing are retained, while non-Bedrock keyframe wrappers (`vector`, nested pre/post.vector) are flattened to Bedrock arrays and unsupported source easing metadata is removed so the actor-animation schema is valid.

CC0 seven-element Book geometry is converted 1:1 to seven Bedrock cubes with source per-face UVs; its single embedded 64x64 production texture is decoded directly. Lucky-owned Fortune Archive places four identical codices on distinct vanilla-material pedestals and uses stable playerInteractWithBlock events for a shared cooperative spatial-memory sequence puzzle.

CC0 Bomb model is eight source elements using one embedded 32x32 production texture. All eight elements and per-face UV data are converted 1:1 into Bedrock block geometry and the embedded PNG is decoded directly. Lucky-owned Fortune Minefield uses twelve of these real bomb blocks in four telegraphed three-bomb waves; active bombs can be mined to disarm while surviving bombs deal scripted non-terrain-destroying blast damage.

Uses the already-verified Ant Soldier geometry/WALK+AMBIENT conversion shared with lb:war_ant_mount instead of duplicating geometry ownership, while vendoring the exact leafcutter_soldier.png source texture. Upstream Ant Soldier is a neutral 15 HP / 5 attack melee mob; Lucky-owned post-dragon role is explicitly different: 260 HP ranged pressure, three-shot telegraphed corrosive salvos, close-range retreat, natural gated spawning, Lucky fragment drops and mixed-role Rift Arsenal placement.

Shares the already-audited Ant Soldier geometry/WALK+AMBIENT conversion used by War Ant Mount and Rift Spitter, and vendors the exact upstream meadow_soldier.png texture. Upstream Ant Soldier is neutral 15 HP / 5 attack melee. Lucky-owned post-dragon adaptation is a 420 HP charge-pressure role with a telegraphed dash, impact knockback, dodge-created 1.35x vulnerability window, gated sparse spawning, Lucky progression drops, Legendary encounter binding and Rift Reliquary placement.

CC0 Shotgun Shell source has exactly two elements and one embedded 16x16 production texture. Both elements and per-face UVs are converted directly into the two-cube Gallery Slug attachable; the embedded PNG is decoded directly. Lucky-owned Fortune Gallery uses it only as temporary trial ammunition with stable itemStartUse + block raycast scoring and cleanup, replacing farmable vanilla snowballs without touching player-owned snowballs.

MIT visual/audio chain port. Source geometry is 18 bones / 83 cubes and differs only by geometry identifier; all 13 source animation tracks are preserved with namespace-only key remaps. Body/eyes PNG and seven selected OGG files are byte-identical. Source Java defaults are 60 HP, 6 attack, 0.3 movement and 100 follow range, with stare/chase/flee plus crawling/climbing/door interaction. Lucky-owned adaptation is a post-dragon 340 HP / 20 chase-damage underground stalker using stable Bedrock Script API gaze detection and shared stalk/spotted/chase/flee phases. Full source wall-climb/crawl/door-breaking behavior is not claimed implemented. 0.39 runtime correction: numeric animation transforms/timing are retained, while non-Bedrock keyframe wrappers (`vector`, nested pre/post.vector) are flattened to Bedrock arrays and unsupported source easing metadata is removed so the actor-animation schema is valid.

CC0 Flash Bang source has 18 elements and one embedded 16x16 production texture. Held and thrown Bedrock geometry preserve all 18 source elements, rotations and per-face UVs; the embedded PNG is decoded exactly. Lucky behavior is a throwable timed flash/control tool with multiplayer PvP safeguards.

CC0 Smoke Grenade source has 9 elements and one embedded 16x16 production texture. Held/thrown geometry preserves all 9 source elements and UVs; texture is decoded exactly. Lucky behavior creates a persisted smoke zone using stable vanilla minecraft:basic_smoke_particle, giving players concealment while blinding/slowing nearby non-player entities.

CC0 Guitar source has 9 elements and one embedded 32x32 production texture. All 9 elements, rotations and UVs are directly converted. Lucky-owned role is a reusable non-combat party support instrument with a cooldown-based Encore.

Uses the separate AntWorker model rather than shared AntSoldier geometry. Source worker is 5 HP / 0.22 movement with a 12-cube model, six-bone WALK animation and renderer scale 1.2; meadow_worker.png is vendored byte-identically. Lucky-owned post-dragon role is a 300 HP phase/burrow ambusher with restart-safe countdowns, temporary invisibility, relocation, slow-zone emergence, sparse gated spawning and Reliquary role integration. Optional upstream cargo layer is not claimed active.

CC0 Mirror source is 11 elements with one embedded 64x64 production texture. All element transforms and per-face UVs are directly converted and the embedded PNG is decoded unchanged. Lucky-owned interaction removes supported negative status effects and grants paired positive effects, consuming only when an inversion actually occurs.

CC0 Gravestone source is 8 elements with one embedded 64x64 production texture. Geometry/UV data and embedded PNG are directly ported. Lucky-owned behavior keeps bounded world-persisted last-death records and consumes the Gravestone only after a safe cross-dimension recall succeeds.

CC0 Air Conditioner source is 11 elements with one embedded 64x64 production texture. Geometry/UVs and texture are direct ports. Lucky-owned one-use cooling clears nearby fire/soul fire, extinguishes burning entities, and gives nearby players temporary Fire Resistance.

LGPL Lich geometry is 161 bones / 233 cubes and is data-identical after geometry-identifier remap; all 11 source animation tracks are preserved with namespace-key remap only. Entity texture and eight directly used BOMD OGG files are byte-identical. Source identity includes missiles, comet, phantom summons, teleport and rage; Lucky reimplements those roles in stable Bedrock Script API at 2800 HP as a post-dragon Legendary summoner/miniboss. Source global eternal-night time mutation is intentionally not reproduced; boss HUD dark-sky presentation avoids global multiplayer time grief. 0.39 runtime correction: numeric animation transforms/timing are retained, while non-Bedrock keyframe wrappers (`vector`, nested pre/post.vector) are flattened to Bedrock arrays and unsupported source easing metadata is removed so the actor-animation schema is valid.
